# Hanyu Wang > Hanyu Wang (GitHub: Nozidoali) is a PhD student in Computer Science at UCLA, advised by Prof. Jason Cong in the VAST research group. He works on mathematical optimization problems in electronic design automation (EDA): quantum circuit synthesis and compilation, logic synthesis, high-level synthesis (HLS), and LLM agents for hardware design-space exploration. Background: MSc in Electrical Engineering and Information Technology from ETH Zurich (DYNAMO group, Prof. Lana Josipović; research at EPFL Integrated Systems Laboratory with Prof. Giovanni De Micheli); BEng from the UM-SJTU Joint Institute, Shanghai Jiao Tong University (logic synthesis with Prof. Weikang Qian). Contact: hanyuwang@g.ucla.edu · ORCID: https://orcid.org/0009-0007-5230-9615 · Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=24DcKqMAAAAJ ## Pages - [About](https://nozidoali.github.io/): bio and selected publications - [Publications](https://nozidoali.github.io/publications/): full publication list with BibTeX; selected papers have detail pages with abstracts under /publications/<slug>/ - [Projects](https://nozidoali.github.io/projects/): research and course projects - [CV](https://nozidoali.github.io/cv/): full curriculum vitae ([PDF](https://nozidoali.github.io/assets/pdf/cv.pdf)) ## Machine-readable data - [research.json](https://nozidoali.github.io/research.json): structured list of all publications (title, authors, venue, DOI, arXiv, code, page) - [papers.bib](https://nozidoali.github.io/assets/bib/papers.bib): full BibTeX file ## Selected publications - SegFold: Accelerating Sparse GEMM with a Fine-Grained Dynamic Dataflow.
